original_question: Sue yana zaune a cikin unguwa mai daɗi. Wani karshen mako, makwabta sun yanke shawarar zolayar Sue. A safiyar Juma'a, makwabta sun sanya tsuntsun flamingos na robobi ruwan hoda guda 18 a farfajiyar Sue. A safiyar ranar Asabar, makwabta sun dawo da kashi daya bisa uku na tsuntsayen flamingos din, sai suka yi musu farin fenti, suka mayar da wadannan sabbin tsuntsun flamingos farfajiyar Sue. Sannan, a safiyar Lahadi, sun kara wasu tsuntsun flamingos na roba18 ruwan hoda a cikin tarin wadan can. Da tsakar ranar Lahadi, tsuntsun flamingos na robobi nawa ne suka fita fiye da fararen?
